bundle.shortDescription: Local-first catalog for your AI coding projects and sessions.
bundle.longDescription: Code Hangar inventories the projects and chat sessions your AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and more) leave on your machine. Browse and search them, understand each folder, find duplicates and orphaned model files, then reclaim disk space through verified backup, reversible holding and an explicit project/batch final-cleanup review. The catalog remains on this PC and is encrypted at rest.
